modal.title: User Guide
modal.description: This guide provides information on how to use the system based on your role.

gettingStarted.title: Getting Started
gettingStarted.welcome: Welcome to OptiMind ERP! This guide will help you navigate the system and understand your capabilities.

navItems.sidebar: Use the sidebar menu to access different modules
navItems.profile: Click your profile icon (top-right) to access settings and logout
navItems.overview: The Overview page shows quick access tiles for your available modules
navItems.notifications: Notifications appear in the bell icon and Overview page

createRequestSteps.step5: Save as draft or Submit for approval
